tasks.label: docker:dev:up
tasks.command: docker compose --profile default -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d

tasks.label: docker:dev:down
tasks.command: docker compose --profile default -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down

tasks.label: docker:dev:prepare-debugger
tasks.command: docker compose --profile default -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T api sh -c 'if [ ! -x /root/vsdbg/vsdbg ]; then command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip); curl -sSL https://aka.ms/getvsdbgsh | /bin/sh /dev/stdin -v latest -l /root/vsdbg; fi'
